from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pt-skill-", ignore_cleanup_errors=True) as staging:
    checkout = Path(staging) / "point-taken"
    subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--local", str(root), str(checkout)], check=True)
    for name in ("scripts/Deploy-PointTaken.ps1", "scripts/Register-PointTakenUser.ps1"):
        shutil.copyfile(root / name, checkout / name)
    shutil.copytree(root / "skill/point-taken", checkout / "skill/point-taken", dirs_exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(["pwsh", "-NoProfile", "-File", "./scripts/Deploy-PointTaken.ps1"], cwd=checkout, check=True)
'@ | python -
